# Web Scraper Toolkit

> Production-grade, agent-operable web scraping arsenal. Stealth browsing (Camoufox/
> Scrapling/Playwright), WAF-aware backend selection, form detection + auto-filling,
> CAPTCHA solving (2captcha/anti-captcha), Google Maps lead-gen, file→Markdown
> conversion (PDF/DOCX/XLSX/images), authenticated scraping via local browser cookies,
> RSS, sitemap crawling, proxy rotation, traffic capture (HAR), distributed crawling.
> MCP server included: `venv/bin/python mcp_server.py` (stdio).

- Interpreter: `venv/bin/python` inside this directory. All deps installed there.
- Tool façade (13 capabilities, JSON-in/JSON-out, never raises):
  `venv/bin/python agent_tools.py <tool> --args '<JSON>'` — list: `--list`
- MCP config for Claude-style clients:
  `{"mcpServers": {"web-scraper": {"command": "<abs>/venv/bin/python", "args": ["<abs>/mcp_server.py"]}}}`

## Tools (agent_tools.py)

- scrape: WAF-fingerprint → auto backend (Camoufox/Playwright/httpx/Scrapling) → export JSON/CSV/MD/HTML/SQLite. Args: url, profile?, scrapling?, solve_captcha?, screenshot?
- fetch: Scrapling TLS-impersonated HTTP (curl_cffi) or stealth/dynamic browser. Args: url, mode?(http|stealth|dynamic), selectors?(dict), impersonate?
- extract_forms: form + field JSON schema (name/id/label/type/required/options). Args: url
- fill_form: detect, fill, submit; radio/select matched case-insensitively by value or label; checkbox groups = lists. Args: url, values(dict), submit?, form_index?, screenshot?
- solve_captcha: detect widget → solve via 2captcha/anti-captcha → inject token → submit. Args: url, type?(auto|recaptcha|recaptcha-v3|hcaptcha|turnstile), site_key?, pre_fill?, submit_selector?
- maps_leads: Google Maps businesses: title/phone/emails/website/category/address/rating + optional socials. Needs `docker compose -f maps.compose.yml up -d`. Args: keywords[], city?|lat/lon?, depth?, email?, socials?
- file_to_markdown: PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/HTML/images/audio/URL → Markdown (markitdown). Args: source, output?, max_chars?
- convert_html: HTML string → Markdown. Args: html
- saas_extract: homepage + pricing/features/about subpages → structured content (SSRF-guarded). Args: url, subpages?
- rss_read: RSS/Atom → items. Args: url, limit?
- auth_scrape: scrape logged-in pages using local browser cookies (least-privilege, domain-scoped). Args: url, browser?(chrome|firefox|edge|brave|opera)
- grab_images: full-page screenshot + bulk image download. Args: url|urls[]
- sitemap_crawl: robots.txt + sitemap.xml URL discovery. Args: url, limit?

## Env / prerequisites

- CAPTCHA solving requires a paid key: `CAPTCHA_API_KEY` (+ `CAPTCHA_SERVICE=2captcha|anti-captcha`).
- Maps lead-gen requires the local gosom API: `docker compose -f maps.compose.yml up -d` (http://localhost:8080, localhost-only).
- One-time browser binaries: `camoufox fetch`, `playwright install chromium`.

## Safety

- Respect robots.txt/ToS; scraped contact data is personal — save to disk, don't dump into chat.
- All untrusted URLs (maps listings, subpage discovery) pass SSRF guards (security_utils.py).
